items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen, opens pre-orders for Gemini-powered smart glasses
items.summary: Google's VP of the Gemini app, Josh Woodward, announced that Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now live in the Gemini app, calling it fast, smart and "a big jump." Box CEO Aaron Levie said an early-access run on Box's internal Complex Work Eval scored it 5 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash while finishing tasks in under half the time and using about 12% fewer tokens. Google also opened pre-orders for its Gemini-powered audio smart glasses, designed with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, shipping December 10.
items.whyItMatters: A faster, cheaper Flash-tier Gemini is a good candidate for latency-sensitive tutor chores (intent routing, quick grammar checks) where Romain and Anna don't need a frontier model's full cost.

items.title: ElevenLabs adds Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL to ElevenAgents, claims 70% lower cost
items.summary: At its November 11 New York Summit, ElevenLabs said customers can now run post-trained versions of Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL inside ElevenAgents. ElevenLabs reports leading task-completion accuracy on its customer-support benchmark at 70% lower cost than other leading open models, plus a reasoning-off mode that ranks among the platform's three fastest options. The companies are adding 15MW of Blackwell Ultra/Vera Rubin compute, with Poland's national e-Health platform as the first government deployment.
items.whyItMatters: A materially cheaper, fast open reasoning model built into the ElevenAgents stack is directly relevant to Anna's cost and latency budget if ElevenLabs exposes it as a swappable backend.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO reportedly oversubscribed; pricing set for Nov 18, Nasdaq debut Nov 19
items.summary: Following Monday's roadshow launch, reports say Anthropic's IPO book is multiple times oversubscribed within its $70-$78/share range. Anthropic plans to price shares on November 18 and begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker "ANT" on November 19, with a fully diluted valuation near $1.4 trillion at the top of the range.
items.whyItMatters: Strong demand for Anthropic's IPO is a read on investor confidence in the LLM vendor behind the tutor's reasoning and feedback layer, though it changes no pricing or API terms today.
